description: P32 (plan M6-M9 sections 2.10 and 5.11): a 1.0 s windup that turns the rider onto the giant for its first 70 % and then commits (a line telegraph 40 m along it; the gallop swell sounds at its start), then a straight run at 14 m/s for at most 40 m that passes through the giant's legs: its hit is the body_sweep of the horse's capsule, once per charge, struck as a 4 m attacker (attacker_height_override_m) so the 60 poise reaches a stage-4 giant's legs as about 22. Unparryable; a sidestep off the line or a dodge's invulnerability avoids it. Afterwards the rider wheels away 30-50 m and comes again.
